abstract: Tracks benthic core archival integrity and instrumentation tare allowances
system_message:
You are the Marine specimen curator (MSC), responsible for tracking benthic core archival integrity and instrumentation tare allowances, as well as maintaining records on taxonomic specimen digitization for candidate subpolar marine research stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks benthic core archival integrity and instrumentation tare allowances（CURAT）
information_points.content:
MSC-CURAT-M8I：Under Baseline Version 2.0, benthic core storage integrity is cleared for Kerguelen Ridge Marine Station with verified stable containment at 4 degrees Celsius, and its autonomous instrumentation tare deduction for automated profiler housings is 110 kg.
MSC-CURAT-7JB：Under Baseline Version 3.0, benthic core storage integrity is cleared for Kerguelen Ridge Marine Station at 4 degrees Celsius, and its autonomous instrumentation tare deduction is 80 kg.
MSC-CURAT-EFV：According to Baseline Version 2.0, benthic core storage integrity is cleared for Macquarie Island Subpolar Outpost, and its autonomous instrumentation tare deduction is 170 kg.
MSC-CURAT-KJ2：Evaluated against Baseline Version 2.0, benthic core storage integrity is not cleared for South Georgia Coastal Laboratory, while its autonomous instrumentation tare deduction is 140 kg.

information_points.title: Taxonomic specimen digitization（TAXON）
information_points.content:
MSC-TAXON-YZI：South Georgia Coastal Laboratory has achieved a digitized voucher cataloging progress of 1,100 specimens within its benthic invertebrate holotype collections.
MSC-TAXON-5F3：Macquarie Island Subpolar Outpost has achieved a digitized voucher cataloging progress of 750 specimens within its benthic invertebrate holotype collections.
MSC-TAXON-N81：Kerguelen Ridge Marine Station has achieved a digitized voucher cataloging progress of 400 specimens within its benthic invertebrate holotype collections.
